title: 95 By BP
description: EEG recordings from healthy participants receiving laser-evoked painful stimulation at four individually calibrated intensities (NRS ratings of 2, 4, 6 and 8) applied to the left and right hand dorsum. Each participant completed 80 trials (8 conditions with 10 trials each) and rated the perceived pain intensity on a numerical rating scale after each stimulus. The dataset supports investigation of the neural encoding of pain intensity.
methods_description: Laser stimulation intensity was calibrated per participant from pain thresholds by increasing energy in 0.25 J steps up to the maximum tolerable level. A 4 (intensity: about 2.0, 2.7, 3.4, 4.1 J) x 2 (location: left or right hand dorsum) within-subject design was used, with 10 trials per condition. Participants rated pain on a 0-10 NRS after each stimulus while seated in a quiet room wearing protective goggles.
